Plan items 15-19 with decisions B6, B7, B8. Depends on FEAT-003 (Engine), FEAT-004 (platform fakes) and FEAT-005 (net). Last feature: finishes with the full V-ALL sweep.
steps: Plan item 15: crates/macwin-agent/src/driver.rs (exported from src/lib.rs) per plan B6: SessionConfig, Backends, kvm_hello (caps input.capture + input.inject, PROTOCOL_VERSION, env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")), peer_info, Connected {link, peer, role}, SessionEnd, SessionHandle {role watch receiver, shutdown(), join()}, spawn_session. Core in Arc<std::sync::Mutex<..>> holding Engine, injector, Arc<dyn CaptureControl>, LinkSender, role watch sender, end; CaptureSink impl locks Core, calls on_local_event(Instant::now()), dispatches, returns deliver; on_fault -> on_capture_fault; tokio::select! loop over link.rx, tick interval (MissedTickBehavior::Delay), shutdown; dispatch executes actions in order (Close -> link.close(code_for) and set end); never await while locked; publish role after every dispatch; capture.stop() on exit. The driver uses only macwin_net::link types, never quinn.

Plan item 15 tests: crates/macwin-agent/tests/e2e_fake.rs cases 1-7 from plan B6 (A = Mac 1440x900 peer Right dialer, B = Windows 1920x1080 peer Left listener, Identity::generate per peer, 127.0.0.1, wait_until(5 s) polling at 10 ms): Hello exchange; A->B crossing with Grab{exit}, MoveTo(0,540), datagram move, Cmd->Ctrl remap; B->A crossing; TakeControl ownership switch (B physical key -> A Release{(1437,450)}, both Idle); raw-net-Session peer disconnect (close_now) releases all held keys/buttons on B; raw peer silence -> B releases within 1.5-3 s and ends HeartbeatTimeout; graceful shutdown while controlling -> peer receives Leave and releases.

Plan item 16: crates/macwin-agent/src/{logging.rs, cli.rs, spike_net.rs, main.rs} per plan B7: tracing-subscriber to stderr with RUST_LOG (default info); clap derive `identity` and `spike net (--listen|--connect, exactly one) --peer-fp --count (1000) --interval-ms (2)`; identity prints `fingerprint: <hex>` and `config dir: <path>` (stderr notes creation); spike_net::{run_listener(Session), run_dialer(Session, SpikeOpts) -> Report, LatencyStats::from_samples nearest-rank}; Pings answered on the channel they arrived on; heartbeat every 250 ms with HeartbeatMonitor timeout 1.5 s; listener prints `listening on <addr>` (flushed), keeps accepting past handshake failures, exits 0 on peer NORMAL close; dialer prints `stream ...` and `datagram ...` lines with n/lost/p50/p95/p99/max in ms and closes NORMAL; agent binds loopback when the remote is loopback. main: #[tokio::main] multi-thread, ExitCode 1 on error with `{:#}`.

Plan item 16 tests: unit tests for LatencyStats and clap (Cli::command().debug_assert(), exclusive group); crates/macwin-agent/tests/spike_net.rs (in-process listener+dialer on 127.0.0.1, count 50, both paths n=50); crates/macwin-agent/tests/cli.rs spawning env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_macwin") with Command::env("MACWIN_CONFIG_DIR", tempdir): identity twice (same fp, created only first, 0600 on unix), spike net listen 127.0.0.1:0 + connect with --count 20 (exit 0, both report lines), wrong --peer-fp on the dialer -> non-zero exit within 10 s; kill children on failure/timeout.
